snippet.title: v8.9 "Lives Flourish Where Feathers Fall" Trailer – Honkai Impact 3rd
snippet.description:
v8.9 "Lives Flourish Where Feathers Fall" coming soon! Seele Vollerei's new S-rank battlesuit Wings of Panacea debuts!
Main Story Part 2 Chapter XIII "A Rose in a Curtsy", featured event "Maximum Speed: Delivery Dash", and new outfits incoming! Stay tuned!
Voice Artists:
Senadina: Suzuki Minori
Vita: Yoko Hikasa
Seele Vollerei: Mai Nakahara
